who_they_sell_to.quote: Run your voice AI business through a single API. Provision customer accounts, control billing, and manage DID inventory, call records, and financial reconciliation in real-time.

pricing_model.text: Pay-as-you-go pricing billed per minute or per message with no long-term contracts.
pricing_model.quote: Pay only for what you use. No setup fees, no hidden costs, no long-term contracts.

pricing_model.text: Free tier available to start without commitment.
pricing_model.quote: Start free and scale from 10 calls to 10,000.

pricing_model.text: One-time setup fee equal to one month's rental on new number activations.
pricing_model.quote: New number activations carry a one-time setup fee equal to one month's rental.

pricing_model.text: Enterprise plans providing committed-use discounts, SLAs, BAAs, and dedicated support.
pricing_model.quote: Enterprise plans with committed-use discounts, dedicated support, BAAs and SLAs.

differentiators.text: Built ground-up specifically for AI voice agents rather than adapting traditional human-to-human CPaaS setups.
differentiators.quote: Designed for Human-to-human calling. AI support added later via webhooks and media streams. AI voice agents, from the ground up.

differentiators.text: Performs noise cancellation, packet loss concealment, and FEC directly inside the telephony network.
differentiators.quote: Vobiz cleans and carries the audio inside the telephony network, so your agent hears better and answers faster.

differentiators.text: Offers single-hop media routing at the nearest edge to achieve sub-80ms telephony latency.
differentiators.quote: Single-hop media at the nearest edge. Minimal latency for natural turn-taking.

differentiators.text: Operates active number health management and CNAM registration to reduce carrier spam flags.
differentiators.quote: We run number health as an operated service, not a support article.

current_customers.text: Integrates with AI voice platforms such as Vapi, Retell AI, LiveKit, ElevenLabs, Pipecat, and OpenAI Realtime.
current_customers.quote: Works with Vapi , Retell AI , LiveKit , Pipecat , ElevenLabs and OpenAI Realtime .

current_customers.text: Integrates with enterprise CRMs and helpdesks including Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, and Pipedrive.
current_customers.quote: Agents call from the record they are on in Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Pipedrive and more, and every call is logged back with its recording.

countries_served.text: Direct phone number provisioning across local, mobile, and toll-free DIDs in over 130 countries in the US, APAC (including India), and EMEA regions.
countries_served.quote: Give your voice agent a number in 130+ countries

countries_served.text: Outbound call connectivity reaching over 190 countries.
Per-minute rates and number rental availability across 224 countries.
countries_served.quote: Per-minute SIP trunk rates and number rental prices for 224 countries.
